script:
title "Losing Trick Count against spade tricks"
# Does the Losing Trick Count predict tricks? North-South with eight or more
# spades between them: the tricks LTC predicts against the spade tricks they
# can take, double dummy.
#
# LTC predicts 24 minus the partnership's combined losers. The second table
# shows how far the real number lands from that, and which way.

fit       = spades(north) + spades(south) >= 8
ns_losers = losers(north) + losers(south)
t_north   = tricks(north, spades)
t_south   = tricks(south, spades)
ns_tricks = t_north > t_south ? t_north : t_south
predicted = 24 - ns_losers

condition fit

action
  average   "NS losers"                  ns_losers,
  average   "NS spade tricks"            ns_tricks,
  average   "Tricks beyond LTC"          ns_tricks - predicted,
  frequency "LTC prediction against spade tricks"
            (predicted, 4, 13, ns_tricks, 4, 13),
  frequency "Tricks beyond LTC"          (ns_tricks - predicted, -4, 4)
